articles.title: Injective launches onchain futures market tracking Nvidia GPU rental costs
articles.snippet: The new index tracks rental prices for five Nvidia GPUs, offering leveraged trading and potential hedging against fluctuations in AI computing costs.

articles.title: Kalshi strikes deal with S&P Dow Jones Indices to expand financial event contracts
articles.snippet: The agreement adds S&P Dow Jones gauges to a growing list of Wall Street firms expanding their involvement in prediction markets.

articles.title: ECB official sees digital euro as key to protecting EU ‘sovereignty’
articles.snippet: Piero Cipollone said the bloc is on track to test real transactions in 2027 and roll out a digital euro as early as 2029, pending legislation this year.

articles.title: 'Privacy Horror’: Researcher Uncovers Extent of Samsung Smart TV User Tracking
articles.snippet: AI-powered reverse engineering could make it "easier and faster" for researchers to uncover and explain how devices collect and share data.

articles.title: Bitcoin’s Bear Market Is Over, Galaxy Research Says: 'Now Is an Attractive Time to Buy'
articles.snippet: Galaxy Research says Bitcoin’s bear market ended in June, pointing to a reclaimed 50-week moving average, fading selling pressure, and a strengthening debasement case.
